scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Persons with Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Person with Disability

Disability must be one of: Blindness, Low‑Vision, Leprosy‑cured persons, Hearing Impairment (deaf & Hard of hearing), Locomotor Disability, Dwarfism, Intellectual Disability, Mental Illness, Autism Spectrum Disorder, Cerebral Palsy, Muscular Dystrophy, Chronic Neurological Condition, Specific Learning Disabilities, Multiple Sclerosis, Speech and Language disability, Thalassemia, Hemophilia, Sickle Cell Disease, Multiple Disabilities including deaf‑blindness, Acid attack Victim, Parkinson's Disease
If the family has children aged 6 to 14 years, those children must be enrolled in a school recognized by the Government of Tripura
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 transferred directly to the applicant’s bank account.
